# Books
## Preprocess data
```{r}

# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)

# Read the data
book_data <- read.csv("parsed_books.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
speech_data <- read.csv("parsed_speech.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Define the valid tag entity categories (including "Other")
valid_tag_entities <- c("Biological Kind", "Artifacts", "Social Kind/Role", "Non-Living Kind", "Other")

# Define pronoun list (you should replace this with your actual list)
pronouns <- c("i", "we",
              "you",
              "he", "she", "it",
              "they",
              "me", "us",
              "him", "her", 
              "them",
              "myself", "ourselves",
              "yourself", "yourselves",
              "himself", "herself", "itself",
              "themselves")

# Function to process each dataset
process_data <- function(df, source_name) {
  # Filter rows where category == 4
  #df_filtered <- df %>% filter(quantified_classification=="Universal Quantifier")
  df_filtered <- df
  
  # Convert tag_word and subject to lowercase for matching
  df_filtered <- df_filtered %>%
    mutate(tag_word_lower = tolower(tag_word),
           subject_lower = tolower(subject),
           is_pronoun = subject_lower %in% pronouns)  # Check if subject is a pronoun
  
  # Find matches where tag_word == subject and subject is not a pronoun
  matched_rows <- df_filtered %>% filter(tag_word_lower == subject_lower)

  # Assign "Other" if tag_entity is not in the valid set
  matched_rows <- matched_rows %>%
    mutate(tag_entity_new = ifelse(tag_entity %in% valid_tag_entities, tag_entity, "Other"))

  # Create new columns for response
  matched_rows <- matched_rows %>%
    mutate(response = 1, source = source_name)

  # Generate four additional rows per match with response = 0 (now including "Other")
  additional_rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(1:nrow(matched_rows), function(i) {
    row <- matched_rows[i, ]
    remaining_entities <- setdiff(valid_tag_entities, row$tag_entity_new)  # Include "Other"
    additional <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = ncol(row), nrow = 4))  # 4 rows instead of 3
    colnames(additional) <- colnames(row)
    
    for (j in 1:4) {
      additional[j, ] <- row
      additional$response[j] <- 0
      additional$tag_entity_new[j] <- remaining_entities[j]
    }
    return(additional)
  }))

  # Combine matched rows with additional rows
  df_processed <- rbind(matched_rows, additional_rows)

  # Select only required columns
  df_processed <- df_processed %>% select(tag_entity_new, response, sentence, source, is_pronoun)

  return(df_processed)
}

# Process both datasets
processed_books <- process_data(book_data, "book")
processed_speech <- process_data(speech_data, "speech")

# Merge the two datasets
merged_data <- rbind(processed_books, processed_speech)

# Rename columns for clarity
colnames(merged_data) <- c("entity_type_new", "response", "sentence", "source", "is_pronoun")

# Display first few rows to verify
head(merged_data)



```



```{r}
# logistic regression for including pronouns, generics

# Convert categorical variables to factors
merged_data$source <- as.factor(merged_data$source)
merged_data$response <- as.factor(merged_data$response)  # Required for logistic regression

# Set "Artifacts" as the reference level in entity_type_new
merged_data$entity_type_new <- factor(merged_data$entity_type_new, 
                                      levels = c("Artifacts", "Biological Kind", "Social Kind/Role", "Non-Living Kind"))
# Fit the logistic regression model with an interaction term
logistic_model <- glm(response ~ source * entity_type_new, data = merged_data, family = binomial)

# Display model summary
summary(logistic_model)

# Obtain estimated marginal means (EMMs) for each entity type within each source
emm <- emmeans(logistic_model, ~ entity_type_new | source, type = "response")

# Get pairwise contrasts comparing everything against "Artifacts" separately for books and speech
contrast_results <- contrast(emm, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = 1, by = "source")

# Print the contrast results
print(contrast_results)



```


```{r}
emm <- emmeans(logistic_model, ~ source + entity_type_new | source, type = "response")
contrast_book <- contrast(emm, method = "pairwise", by="source")  # Separate for each source
print(contrast_book)

```

```{r}
# make big plot
# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Function to compute confidence intervals
compute_ci <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    filter(tag_entity_new != "Other") %>%  # Filter out "Other" category
    group_by(tag_entity_new, source) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_response = mean(response, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = n(),
      se = sd(response, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
      ci = qt(0.975, df = n-1) * se
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# Compute proportions and confidence intervals for all datasets
book_ci <- compute_ci(processed_books)
speech_ci <- compute_ci(processed_speech)
book_pronoun_ci <- compute_ci(processed_books_pronouns)
speech_pronoun_ci <- compute_ci(processed_speech_pronouns)

# Manually add Gelman and Mehrotra values
gelman_mehrotra <- data.frame(
  tag_entity_new = c("Biological Kind", "Artifacts",
                     "Biological Kind", "Artifacts"),
  source = c("Gelman", "Gelman", "Mehrotra", "Mehrotra"),
  mean_response = c(0.43, 0.26, 0.33, 0.47),
  n = NA,
  se = NA,
  ci = NA
)

# Combine all datasets
plot_data <- bind_rows(
  book_ci %>% mutate(source = "book"),
  speech_ci %>% mutate(source = "speech"),
  book_pronoun_ci %>% mutate(source = "book_pronouns"),
  speech_pronoun_ci %>% mutate(source = "speech_pronouns"),
  gelman_mehrotra
) %>%
  mutate(
    section = case_when(
      source == "Gelman" ~ "Gelman",
      source == "Mehrotra" ~ "Mehrotra",
      source == "speech" ~ "Speech (no pronouns)",
      source == "book" ~ "Books (no pronouns)",
      source == "speech_pronouns" ~ "Speech (pronouns)",
      source == "book_pronouns" ~ "Books (pronouns)",
      TRUE ~ source
    ),
    section = factor(section, 
                    levels = c("Gelman", "Mehrotra",
                             "Speech (no pronouns)", "Books (no pronouns)",
                             "Speech (pronouns)", "Books (pronouns)"))
  )

# Define consistent entity order for dodging (without "Other")
entity_order <- c("Biological Kind", "Artifacts", "Non-Living Kind", "Social Kind/Role")
plot_data$tag_entity_new <- factor(plot_data$tag_entity_new, levels = entity_order)

# Create the plot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = section, y = mean_response, fill = tag_entity_new)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", 
          position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), 
          width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_response - ci, 
        ymax = mean_response + ci), 
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.2,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1),
                    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    x = "Dataset",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Entity Type",
    title = "Proportion of Different Entity Types Across Datasets",
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),  # Smaller legend title
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),   # Smaller legend text
    legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "lines"),   # Smaller legend keys
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.2, 'cm'),     # Less spacing between legend items
    legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0, unit = "pt")  # Reduce margin around legend
)


```






```{r}
# age analysis: generics, no pronouns, book

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)

parsed_books <- read_csv("parsed_books.csv") |> 
  mutate(
    sentence_type = case_when(
      category == 3 ~ "generic",
      category == 4 ~ "habitual",
      quantified_classification == "Universal Quantifier" ~ "universal_quantification",
      .default = "other"
    ) |> factor(levels = c("other", "generic", "habitual", "universal_quantification")),
    
    is_pronoun = tolower(subject) %in% pronouns
  )

books_matched <- parsed_books |> 
  filter(tolower(tag_word) == tolower(subject), is_pronoun == FALSE) |>  # Filter out pronouns
  mutate(
    subject_kind = case_when(
      tag_entity == "Artifacts" ~ "artifacts",
      tag_entity == "Biological Kind" ~ "biological",
      tag_entity == "Non-Living Kind" ~ "nonliving",
      tag_entity == "Social Kind/Role" ~ "social",
      .default = "other"
    ) |> factor(levels = c("artifacts", "biological", "nonliving", "social", "other")) |> 
      `contrasts<-`(value = contr.sum(5)),

    # Add new binary columns
    generic = ifelse(sentence_type == "generic", 1, 0),
    habitual = ifelse(sentence_type == "habitual", 1, 0),
    universal_quantification = ifelse(sentence_type == "universal_quantification", 1, 0)
  ) |> 
  # Expand rows for each age between age_min and age_max
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(age = list(seq(age_min, age_max, by = 1))) |>  # Create a sequence of ages
  unnest(age) |>  # Expand rows based on the age list
  ungroup()




```

summary(generic_model)

```{r}
# age analysis: generics, no pronouns, books

parsed_speech <- read_csv("parsed_speech.csv") |> 
  mutate(
    sentence_type = case_when(
      category == 3 ~ "generic",
      category == 4 ~ "habitual",
      quantified_classification == "Universal Quantifier" ~ "universal_quantification",
      .default = "other"
    ) |> factor(levels = c("other", "generic", "habitual", "universal_quantification")),
    is_pronoun = tolower(subject) %in% pronouns)

speech_matched <- parsed_speech |> 
  filter(tolower(tag_word) == tolower(subject), , is_pronoun == FALSE) |> 
  mutate(
    subject_kind = case_when(
      tag_entity == "Artifacts" ~ "artifacts",
      tag_entity == "Biological Kind" ~ "biological",
      tag_entity == "Non-Living Kind" ~ "nonliving",
      tag_entity == "Social Kind/Role" ~ "social",
      .default = "other"
    ) |> factor(levels = c("artifacts", "biological", "nonliving", "social", "other")) |> 
      `contrasts<-`(value = contr.sum(5)),
     # Add new binary columns
    generic = ifelse(sentence_type == "generic", 1, 0),
    habitual = ifelse(sentence_type == "habitual", 1, 0),
    universal_quantification = ifelse(sentence_type == "universal_quantification", 1, 0),
    age = rowMeans(cbind(age_min, age_max), na.rm = TRUE))


```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)  # for arranging plots side by side
library(scales)     # for percent formatting

# -----------------------------
# For the Books Data Frame
# -----------------------------
books_prop <- books_matched %>%
  group_by(age) %>%
  summarize(
    total      = n(),
    generics   = sum(sentence_type == "generic"),
    proportion = generics / total,
    se         = sqrt(proportion * (1 - proportion) / total),
    lower      = pmax(proportion - 1.96 * se, 0),
    upper      = pmin(proportion + 1.96 * se, 1),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

books_plot <- ggplot(books_prop, aes(x = age, y = proportion)) +
  geom_line(color = "black", size = 1) +
  # Replace geom_errorbar() with geom_linerange() for vertical error bars without horizontal caps.
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), color = "black") +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 4, color = "black", fill = "lightgray") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, limits = c(1, 12)) +
  # Display y-axis values as percentages.
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(x = "Age", y = "Proportion of Generics", title = "Books") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    # Remove vertical grid lines.
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    # Add black axis lines.
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black")
  )

# -----------------------------
# For the Speech Data Frame
# -----------------------------
speech_prop <- speech_matched %>%
  group_by(age) %>%
  summarize(
    total      = n(),
    generics   = sum(sentence_type == "generic"),
    proportion = generics / total,
    se         = sqrt(proportion * (1 - proportion) / total),
    lower      = pmax(proportion - 1.96 * se, 0),
    upper      = pmin(proportion + 1.96 * se, 1),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

speech_plot <- ggplot(speech_prop, aes(x = age, y = proportion)) +
  geom_line(color = "black", size = 1) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), color = "black") +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 4, color = "black", fill = "lightgray") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, limits = c(1, 12)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(x = "Age", y = "Proportion of Generics", title = "Speech") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black")
  )

# -----------------------------
# Combine the two plots side by side
# -----------------------------
combined_plot <- books_plot + speech_plot

# Display the combined plot
print(combined_plot)

# Save the combined plot as a PDF.
ggsave("combined_plot.pdf", plot = combined_plot, width = 12, height = 6)



```
